crates_created.name: oya-foundry-adapter-anthropic-compat-api
crates_created.bnf_justification: oya-<microservice:foundry>-<bc:adapter-anthropic-compat>-<layer:api>; v4.1 conformant; bounded-context=adapter-anthropic-compat keeps Anthropic-shape passthrough isolated from upstream provider primitive adapters; layer=api per workspace 12-layer enum (HTTP route surface, request/response types, translator).
crates_created.purpose: Anthropic /v1/messages + /v1/messages/count_tokens passthrough. Translates Anthropic shape ↔ internal CapabilityInvokeRequest, emits Anthropic-style SSE event sequence (message_start, content_block_start, …, message_stop).
crates_created.linus_good_taste: Eliminated dual streaming/non-streaming code paths — non-streaming collapses to a single chunk on the same stream surface.

http_backbone: hyper via oya-http-router-kernel + oya-http-sse-domain (NO axum, NO tower-http per workspace directive 2026-05-14)
provider_isolation: Anthropic-specific code only inside this crate; pool routing kernel (IP-001) stays provider-agnostic.
open_items: Distroless image build deferred to runtime-adapter layer (this IP ships the pure API kernel surface; the hyper-backed runtime wires it via oya-http-runtime-hyper-adapter).
contracts/foundry-compat-anthropic-v1.openapi.yaml deferred — workspace validators reject incomplete OpenAPI YAMLs; the IP-005 drift kernel diffs JSON contract fingerprints instead.
